method: Each authority was reconstructed from production source by locating every writer/reader and reading the owning code. Tests were neither read nor used as evidence.

authorities.inputTrustBoundary: JWT verified in services/api/src/middleware/auth.ts; userId is never read from body/query/header
authorities.evidence: One User row per account. Organization membership is a separate row (OrganizationMembership) and never mints a second identity — no code path creates a User as a side effect of joining an Organization.

authorities.databaseModel: Team (teams) — @@map("teams") is the storage-level legacy name for the canonical Workspace
authorities.transactionBoundary: routes/teams.routes.ts wraps org-create + membership-grant + team-create in one prisma.$transaction with pg_advisory_xact_lock
authorities.evidence: All 4 writers set workspaceKind explicitly. No fifth writer exists.

authorities.databaseModel: Team.workspaceKind (enum WorkspaceKind, NULLABLE) + legacy Team.isPersonal boolean
authorities.validation: Fail-closed: teamLoaded=false -> UNKNOWN; isPersonal unprovable -> UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN denies in access-policy and is excluded from the context switcher
authorities.defect: The DB does not enforce the discriminator (column is nullable, no CHECK, no NOT NULL). A NULL row falls back to a plan-derived rule (billingPlan==='ENTERPRISE' -> ORGANIZATION), which is plan-inferring-kind. Bounded to the migration window only; all 4 live writers set it explicitly. See ARCH-002.

authorities.canonicalWriter: services/api/src/services/enterprise-provisioning.service.ts (kind: CUSTOMER) + routes/teams.routes.ts:433 (kind: SYSTEM, the internal 1:1 bootstrap container)
authorities.readers: services/api/src/services/organization/org-access.ts:checkOrgAccess is the ONE org-level authorization decision
authorities.evidence: checkOrgAccess denies on ARCHIVED and SUSPENDED before reading membership; only CUSTOMER orgs are governance boundaries (resolveEnterpriseContract returns null for SYSTEM).

authorities.canonicalWriter: services/api/src/services/identity/membership-provisioning.service.ts (grant / suspend / reactivate / revoke / mass-*), provenance-normalized via MembershipGrant
authorities.defect: The canonical reader is correct and status-aware. 54 production reads of teamMember.* neither constrain nor consume status; most are secondary or non-authorizing, but a confirmed subset act as the PRIMARY access gate. See AUTH-001, AUTH-002, AUTH-003.

authorities.evidence: Revocation is a physical DELETE (membership-provisioning.service.ts:908, :989), so 'inactive membership' is modelled as absence and checkOrgAccess denies correctly. Asymmetric with TeamMember (no SUSPEND state at org level) — see ARCH-004.

gatesApplied: role floor -> capability grant -> delegated admin scope
support-context token: server-verified, actor-bound, session-bound, session-liveness-checked
authorities.errorBehavior: Bounded reason-code vocabulary only; never a Prisma message; 503 on evaluation failure (fail closed); optional antiEnumeration converts membership failures to 404
authorities.auditEvent: recordPermissionDecision -> SecurityEvent permission_denied on every deny
authorities.adoption: 101 of 1,081 routes call it directly; many more reach it through per-file requireXActor helpers that delegate to it.

authorities.databaseModel: User.currentWorkspaceId (a hint, revalidated on every envelope build)
authorities.validation: Available contexts derived from teamMember.findMany({ where: { userId, status: 'ACTIVE' } }); parent Organization must be ACTIVE; UNKNOWN workspaceKind rows are excluded; a stale currentWorkspaceId pointing at a deleted team or a non-ACTIVE membership is cleared and NOT healed into Personal when noPersonalSpace applies
authorities.clientMirror: apps/web/lib/platform-context/PlatformContextProvider.tsx + tenantStorage.ts (tenant-generation stamping, isStale predicate, tenant-namespaced localStorage keys)
authorities.note: The envelope field named `organizations` actually carries Team (workspace) ids — see ARCH-003.

authorities.apiEntryPoint: services/api/src/services/billing/commercial-context.service.ts:resolveCommercialContext with an explicit discriminated CommercialSubject; declared-kind mismatch throws 409 COMMERCIAL_SUBJECT_MISMATCH (fail closed)
authorities.databaseModel: Team.billingPlan/billingStatus/includedSeats (workspace commercial state) + Entitlement(userId, plan) which is the PERSONAL_ACCOUNT subject only
authorities.evidence: Direction of inference is kind -> plan, never plan -> kind. PERSONAL resolves from the owner entitlement; OWNED honours only a live TEAM workspace subscription and fails closed on a legacy ENTERPRISE string; ORGANIZATION resolves from the CUSTOMER org contract; UNKNOWN -> FREE. PAYG is never promoted to a recurring workspace plan.

authorities.concurrencyControl: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('owned-workspace-create:<ownerUserId>')) then re-count inside the same transaction
authorities.countPredicate: ownerUserId AND isPersonal=false AND NOT organization.kind='CUSTOMER' — Personal Space and provisioned Organization workspaces are both excluded

authorities.canonicalWriter: services/worker/src/queue.ts (17 Queue objects) + packages/shared/src/queue-integrity/ (names, registry, enqueue, job-id, payload decoder, retry policy)
authorities.processors: services/worker/src/index.ts — 15 safeRegisterWorker registrations, one per non-DLQ queue
authorities.evidence: Runtime wiring was discovered independently and then compared with the registry: 17 registry QUEUE_NAMES == 17 runtime Queue objects; 2 DLQs intentionally have no processor; producer-without-processor = 0; processor-without-producer = 0. API-side producers construct queues from the same shared name constants, so producer/processor name drift is structurally impossible.

authorities.databaseModel: Evidence.teamId (+ Evidence.organizationId relation EvidenceOrganization, onDelete Restrict)
authorities.guestIdentity: GuestIdentity is an association only (guest_identities.user_id unique); it is never used as tenant authority — Evidence still carries teamId

authorities.defect: evaluateCrossTeamAttach correctly refuses case.teamId != evidence.teamId. But case-permission.service.ts:310 resolves the caller's workspace role without consulting TeamMember.status. See AUTH-003.

The canonical helper exists and is correct. apps/web/app/(app)/search/page.tsx:708 keys recent searches by teamId but with its own ad-hoc prefix instead of tenantStorageKey — correct isolation, duplicate convention. See WEB-002. All other raw localStorage use is non-tenant (consent, i18n, dismissal flags, auth token removal).

authorities.canonicalWriter: apps/web/middleware.ts (mints a per-request nonce, sets it on BOTH the request headers Next reads and the response header) + apps/web/app/layout.tsx (export const dynamic = "force-dynamic")
authorities.evidence: The nonce-CSP-vs-prerender hazard is closed at this revision: the root layout forces per-request rendering so no page is emitted with nonce=$undefined, and the middleware matcher /((?!_next|favicon.ico).*) covers every page.
